value.answer: Depends on whether you're putting down under 20%. If yes (insured), the lowest 5-year fixed is about 4.34%. If 20% or more (uninsured), the lowest is about 4.44%. The big banks run higher, averaging around 5.14%, and rates have been creeping up this month.
